flags.held_out_set: R4 release gate: n=1200 Common Voice 17 English clips, speaker-disjoint via client_id, drawn ONLY after excluding every dev/val client_id (assert zero overlap and print the count); clip list hashed (sha256) onto the R4 card and frozen before the first number; bootstrap resampling seed fixed in advance. Dive research/dive/age-gender-audio.md s8.
scoring_rules_pinned: Gender accuracy = argmax over the {female, male} logits only; the child logit is ignored for BOTH our model and the incumbent, so no arm is penalised for predicting child; report alongside the count of clips where the incumbent's top class would have been child.
Age = MAE against decade-bucket midpoints (the model trains on CV decade-bucket targets; floor ~2.5 yr MAE).

Both margins are RELATIVE to the incumbent (audeering/wav2vec2-large-robust-24-ft-age-gender) re-scored on the exact same frozen clips -- never absolute thresholds copied from the R1 census (dive s8 gate form, review E3).
Decision uses the CI BOUND, not the point estimate: 2000 paired-bootstrap resamples over clips, fixed seed.
flags.r4_release_gate: ship 0.1.0 only if BOTH: lower 95% bound of (ours - incumbent) gender accuracy >= -2.0 pp AND upper 95% bound of (ours - incumbent) age MAE <= +1.0 yr, on the frozen n=1200 set; AND int8-ONNX-vs-fp32 parity within 0.5 pp gender / 0.3 yr age. Else close the line -- no rescue variant, no re-tune-and-rerun.
flags.r2_screen_gate: screen (n=600, both seeds, same CI-bound rule): continue only if gender bound >= -3.0 pp and age bound <= +1.5 yr; if R2 misses on both seeds, run ONE layer-weighted-sum probe (<=30 GPU-min) before closing (dive s8).
flags.models: No model id is pinned here (METHODOLOGY 4b): roles/slots resolve from the lab model roster at each run's start and the roster date + picked ids go into that run's result. The incumbent audeering/wav2vec2-large-robust-24-ft-age-gender is the product's drop-in definition, not a roster pick. Roster in effect at freeze: the lab model roster mtime 2026-11-21 17:08. No teacher model (CV labels are task-native self-reported).
flags.claim_wording: 'level with' only -- the gate is a non-inferiority margin; 'beats'/'better' are not allowed and CI bounds must be reported (dive C4). Age claims always say decade-bucket resolution (C2); child logit documented as 'not predicted' plus the measured incumbent child-prediction rate (C1); intended-use/privacy section on model card + repo front page (C3).
